checks.notes: 13 tests, including V2 parent/child closure, cancellation-before-admission, in-flight cancellation, byte-level artifact tampering, and the semantic link matrix.
The crash-recovery test intentionally emits one losing child-process race failure before the harness confirms the parent test passes.
The strict parent verifier rejects a byte-level corruption of either the ChildLinked or ChildClosed immutable content-addressed artifact.
A blocking child effect is released only after parent-family cancellation; the post-effect guard prevents child success and finalization records a cancelled parent.

The matrix covers altered admission ID, duplicate link, duplicate closure, missing closure, terminal-state mismatch, and chain-head mismatch. It rebuilds test-only parent receipts with content-addressed descriptors and valid chain digests; canonical append validation rejects invalid lifecycle records before they can be persisted, otherwise strict runtime verification rejects them.
